final: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share FROM customer_orders), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST) AS place FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share FROM ranked WHERE place <= 10 ORDER BY order_share DESC NULLS LAST, customer_id
